suite: Google Cloud Firestore Emulator Security Rules Suite

results.name: 1. Unauthenticated client cannot access private owner store (/stores/{slug})
2. Unauthenticated client can read public store info (/stores/{slug}/public/info)
3. Unauthenticated client can read public store products (/stores/{slug}/products/{id})
4. Unauthenticated client is blocked from reading user data (/users/{userId})
5. Unauthenticated client is blocked from reading audit logs (/users/{userId}/businesses/{bizId}/auditLog)
6. Anonymous customer can place a valid draft order (/stores/{slug}/orders/{orderId})
7. Malicious order with status == "delivered" is rejected with permission-denied
8. Malicious order with injected unauthorized fields is rejected with permission-denied
9. Malicious order with negative totalAmount is rejected with permission-denied
10. Order on nonexistent store path is rejected with permission-denied
11. Order with id mismatch (path id != document id) is rejected with permission-denied
12. Order with 6 items where the 6th item is malformed is rejected with permission-denied
13. Order without subtotal field where totalAmount does not equal sum of item subtotals is rejected
14. Updating an existing storefront order is rejected (allow update: if false;)
15. Authenticated stranger cannot read owner store (/stores/{slug}), owner can
16. Owner can read/write private ledger days, non-owner authenticated user is blocked with 403
17. Public product blocks private fields (buyPrice, profit, batches) and non-owner reads only public schema
18. Audit log is strictly append-only; cannot be updated or deleted even if meta/info is removed
19. Storefront Mobile Banking numbers (bkashNumber/nagadNumber) & customer order TrxID validation
20. Online Orders: Creation of pre-settled or pre-verified orders is strictly forbidden; draft/confirmed succeeds
21. Online Orders: State transition constraints prevent illegal status jumps
22. P0-1: Order settlement requires atomic day document write synchronization
23. P0-2: Payment verification forbids conflicting status and requires atomic trxRegistry claim
24. TrxID Registry: Entries are strictly append-only; updates and deletes are rejected (403)
25. Settled Orders: Financial fields are immutable and deletion is forbidden (403)
